Brightpath Analytics pricing

Brightpath is licensed per warehouse and billed monthly. Starter is $480 per month, Growth is $1,450 per month, and Enterprise starts at $3,900 per month. There is no setup fee on any plan.

Start a 21-day trial

Starter plan

$480 per month. Covers up to 5 warehouses and 20,000 active SKUs, with daily forecast delivery and email support answered within one business day.

Growth plan

$1,450 per month. Covers up to 20 warehouses and 150,000 active SKUs, adds the REST endpoint, and includes a named implementation contact for the first 90 days.

Enterprise plan

From $3,900 per month. Covers unlimited warehouses, adds single sign-on and a 99.9% uptime commitment, and is billed annually.

What is not included

Custom data connectors are quoted separately and typically cost $4,000 to $12,000 as a one-off. Historical data migration beyond 36 months is also quoted separately.
